description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, causing you to create a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat.
